name: Darth Ruin founds the New Sith

location.note: Ruin's followers gathered across the Rim

summary: The Umbaran Jedi Master Phanius left the Order with fifty followers, took the name Darth Ruin and gathered the scattered Sith cults of the Rim into a new Sith Empire. The Fourth Great Schism opened a thousand years of war.

name: The New Sith Wars
summary: For ten centuries Sith warlords and the Republic traded worlds across the Rim and Mid Rim in a war that never quite ended. Ruin's assassination by his own followers set the pattern: the Sith were as dangerous to each other as to the Jedi.

name: Battle of Mizra
summary: The Sith won a crushing victory at Mizra that marked the turning of the New Sith Wars against the Republic. In its aftermath Sith territory expanded until the Republic held little beyond the Core.

name: The Sictis Wars
summary: One of the many named conflicts within the New Sith Wars, a decade of fighting that further drained a Republic already losing worlds year on year.

name: The Republic Dark Age
summary: With the HoloNet dark, the Senate powerless and whole sectors under Sith rule, the Republic shrank to a besieged Core. Jedi Lords took direct charge of its defence and politics; the century became known as the Dark Age.

name: The Jedi assume leadership of the Republic
summary: As civil government failed, Jedi Masters became Supreme Chancellors and generals, and Jedi Lords ruled worlds as feudal protectors. It saved the Republic and badly compromised the Order's independence.

name: Lord Kaan founds the Brotherhood of Darkness
summary: The former Jedi Skere Kaan reunited the feuding Sith lords as a Brotherhood of equals, abolishing the title of Dark Lord and rebuilding the Korriban academy. Under him the Sith came closer to final victory than at any time since Ruin.

name: Lord Hoth raises the Army of Light
summary: To answer Kaan, the Jedi Lord Hoth gathered thousands of Jedi and Republic volunteers into an Army of Light and took the war to the Brotherhood directly.

name: The Light and Darkness War

location.note: fought from Korriban to the Mid Rim, ending on Ruusan

summary: The final decade of the New Sith Wars pitted Hoth's Army of Light against Kaan's Brotherhood in a running war across the Mid Rim. Both armies finally ground to a halt on the dry world of Ruusan.

name: Dessel of Apatros joins the Sith army
summary: A cortosis miner named Dessel killed a Republic ensign in a brawl and fled Apatros into the Sith army. His raw strength in the Force marked him out, and he was sent to Korriban as the war reached its climax.

name: Bane studies at the Korriban academy
summary: At Kaan's academy Dessel took the name Bane, outstripped his rivals and, in the archives, rediscovered the old doctrine that power should belong to one Dark Lord rather than a brotherhood of equals. He left Korriban convinced Kaan had betrayed the Sith.

name: Bane finds Revan's holocron on Lehon
summary: Following clues from the academy, Bane travelled to Lehon and recovered a holocron Darth Revan had left in the Temple of the Ancients. Revan's teachings on the Rule of Two and the weakness of many Sith shaped everything Bane did next.

name: The battles of Ruusan
summary: Seven battles were fought on Ruusan between Hoth's Army of Light and Kaan's Brotherhood. Bane, having rejoined Kaan to destroy the Brotherhood from within, encouraged him toward ever more desperate measures.

name: Seventh Battle of Ruusan
summary: With the Brotherhood cornered, Kaan led his Sith lords into a cave to prepare a thought bomb while Hoth's Jedi closed in. Bane, who had planted the idea, left the battlefield before it was used.

name: Kaan detonates the thought bomb
summary: Kaan and the Brotherhood pooled their power into a thought bomb and detonated it as Hoth and a hundred Jedi came for them. Every Force-sensitive within range, Sith and Jedi alike, had their spirit torn out and trapped. The Brotherhood of Darkness ceased to exist.

name: Darth Bane walks away from Ruusan
summary: Having goaded Kaan into using the thought bomb and withdrawn in time, Bane was the only Sith lord alive when the dust settled. The Jedi assumed every Sith had died in the blast.

name: The Sith line truly ends at Ruusan
summary: Speculative. Had Bane died with the Brotherhood, the Jedi belief that the Sith were extinct would have been correct, and no hidden lineage would have waited a thousand years for its revenge.
basis: Darth Bane: Path of Destruction makes Bane the sole surviving Sith lord of Ruusan; the Jedi Council of the era declared the Sith destroyed, and the Rule of Two existed only because he lived.

name: Bane takes Zannah as his apprentice
summary: On Ruusan Bane found a ten-year-old girl named Zannah who had killed two Jedi in grief and rage after her cousin's death. He took her as the first apprentice of his new order.

name: Bane establishes the Rule of Two
summary: Bane decreed that there would be only two Sith at any time: a master to hold power and an apprentice to crave it, hidden from the Jedi and plotting over generations. Every Sith Lord from Zannah to Darth Sidious followed that rule.

name: The Ruusan Reformation
summary: Believing the Sith destroyed, Chancellor Tarsus Valorum's reforms demilitarised the Republic, abolished the Jedi Lords and placed the Order under the Senate's authority. The Jedi gave up their armies and their ranks; the Sith, in secret, did not.

name: Bane claims Freedon Nadd's holocron on Dxun
summary: Bane and Zannah crashed on Dxun, where Bane opened Nadd's tomb and took his holocron. Parasitic orbalisks infested his body there, giving him armour he could not remove.

name: Bane trains Zannah in secret
summary: From hidden bases on Ambria and elsewhere, Bane spent a decade teaching Zannah Sith sorcery while posing as a dead man. The Jedi, satisfied the Sith were gone, never looked.

name: A Jedi strike team confronts Bane on Tython
summary: Tipped off that a Sith lord survived, a team of Jedi led by Master Valenthyne Farfalla tracked Bane to Tython. Bane killed most of them and Zannah faked his death convincingly enough that the Jedi closed the case.

name: Zannah kills Darth Bane on Ambria
summary: After twenty years Zannah challenged her master at the healer's camp on Ambria. Bane tried to seize her body with an essence-transfer ritual and failed; Zannah killed him and became Dark Lord, though a fragment of Bane may have lingered in her.

name: Darth Zannah takes Darth Cognus as her apprentice
summary: With Bane dead, Zannah accepted the Iktotchi assassin Cognus as her apprentice, continuing the Rule of Two. The line would run unbroken for nearly a thousand years.

name: The Republic reclaims the Rim after Ruusan
summary: Over the century after Ruusan the Republic reabsorbed the sectors the Sith had held and relit the HoloNet, beginning the long peace that lasted until the Clone Wars.
